rationale.A: ~2 km in mixed traffic: Oulunkyläntie (830 m) and Pohjolankatu with tram rails (650 m); the rest is on tracks beside arterials
rationale.B: Even more mixed traffic than A: Siltavoudintie, 1.2 km of Oulunkyläntie and Pohjolankatu with tram rails
rationale.C: Nearly all on tracks beside arterials (Siltavoudintie, Oulunkyläntie, Koskelantie), 80 m in traffic, many unsignalised crossings
rationale.D: No mixed traffic; tracks beside arterials, then Käpylä station path along the railway; 3 lights; +1 min
rationale.F: Leaves the arterials early for quiet Pakila streets and paths; 2 lights; +3 min
rationale.G: No mixed traffic but long tracks beside Pukinmäenkaari/Tapaninvainiontie; 6 lights
rationale.H: Through Haltiala and Central Park (Pitkäkoski, Keskuspuistontaival); almost entirely away from roads; +6 min

notes: H moves most of a 50-min ride from arterial-side tracks onto Central Park paths for +6 min, which I judged worth it. F (+3) is a reasonable alternative calm pick. D saves 2 lights for +1 min.
